responsibility: Implements builtin Rust #[derive(Eq)] expansion by synthesizing AST impls for both core::cmp::Eq and the structural-equality marker trait. Rather than generating a comparison operator body, this file builds the required assert_receiver_is_total_eq method and supporting AssertParamIsEq<T: Eq + ?Sized> checks so every contained field or variant payload type is proven to implement Eq, collecting those inner types from structs, tuple structs, enums, and unions and attaching the necessary generic trait bounds during impl construction.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for Eq derivation: it defines the logic that gathers contained field or variant types, builds assert_receiver_is_total_eq and AssertParamIsEq checks, and emits the Eq and structural-equality impls, whereas rust-derive-eq.h only declares that expander interface.
